desk.why: Implied is only 0.86x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.

facts: NIFTY moved +2.2% over the last 7 sessions and +1.6% on the day, to 25,801.
Gap -146 pts, then the session added +433 pts.
The day closed at its high (close - low 455, high - close 8).
India VIX 17.33 (+7.5%) - rising on an up day: traders are paying for protection, the rally is nervous.
ATM IV sits in its 60th percentile of the past year: option premium is middling.

base.why: No trend worth leaning on (7-session move +2.2%), so the plan sells both sides at the writers' walls, 25,500 and 26,000, and lets time decay work. Note: the desk's volatility rule says stand aside today (Implied is only 0.86x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.). This plan overrides it only for the scenario branches; size down.
text: bull put spread: sell 25,300 PE, buy 25,100 PE (credit about 35 pts, Rs 2,277 per lot; max loss Rs 10,723)
bear call spread: sell 26,500 CE, buy 26,700 CE (credit about 19 pts, Rs 1,212 per lot; max loss Rs 11,788)

scenarios.title: Breaks out above 26,000
watch: 26,000 CE open interest falling (writers buying back - short covering)
Close near the day's high again
scenarios.means: The ceiling gave way. Next magnets: 26,400 then 26,500.
scenarios.action: Close today's position (take the profit) and open the new one. It would be about Rs 459 in profit per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 26,000 PE / buy 25,800 PE. The old ceiling 26,000 becomes the floor: sell puts at it. No calls below 26,500. Or buy a spread: buy 26,200 CE / sell 26,600 CE. If it spikes past 26,400 in one session with VIX rising, take profit instead of chasing.
scenarios.odds: Reached 26,400 in 23.5% and 26,500 in 19.7% of past cases (normal 29.6% / 23.2%).

scenarios.title: Falls to 25,500 and holds
watch: 25,500 PE open interest still rising (put writers defending)
scenarios.action: If it holds: keep today's position, or add sell 25,100 PE / buy 24,900 PE (weekly). If it breaks: close today's position and switch to sell 25,500 CE / buy 25,700 CE (weekly). Exact strikes for every expiry are in the position matrix.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 25,500 in 48.9% of past cases (normal 45.7%).

scenarios.title: Breaks down below 25,500
watch: 25,500 PE open interest falling (put writers exiting)
scenarios.means: The floor gave way. Next: 25,400 then 25,300.
scenarios.action: Close today's position. It would be about Rs 768 in loss per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 25,500 CE / buy 25,700 CE. The old floor 25,500 becomes the ceiling: sell calls at it. Or buy a spread: buy 25,400 PE / sell 25,000 PE.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 25,400 in 38.2% of past cases (normal 38.0%).

rules: Take profit on any spread once 50% of its credit is earned; the rest is not worth the risk.
Close any spread once its loss reaches 1.5x the credit taken, whatever day that is. Holding into expiry is fine; size smaller on expiry day.
Act on daily closes, not intraday spikes. The OI checks use the next morning's bhavcopy.
Credits for rolls and add-ons are set by prices on the day you act; today's numbers are a guide only.
limits: None of the desk's positioning signals (PCR, max pain, OI flow, walls) has passed its own backtest for this horizon, so the history study is the main evidence.
